<style>.pcanvas{display:block;border-radius:14px;background:#0b0e13;border:1px solid var(--line,#262C34)}</style>
<canvas class="pcanvas" id="pc" width="240" height="130"></canvas>
<script>var cv=document.getElementById('pc'),x=cv.getContext('2d'),ps=[];
for(var i=0;i<48;i++)ps.push({x:Math.random()*240,y:Math.random()*130,r:Math.random()*1.6+.4,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*.35,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*.35});
(function draw(){x.clearRect(0,0,240,130);for(var i=0;i<ps.length;i++){var p=ps[i];p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;if(p.x<0||p.x>240)p.vx*=-1;if(p.y<0||p.y>130)p.vy*=-1;x.beginPath();x.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,7);x.fillStyle='rgba(255,120,60,.85)';x.fill();}requestAnimationFrame(draw);})();</script>
